messages:
sanjay: Heads up — after the kernel roll to q4_fastpath I'm seeing ~12-18% tail host CPU increase under mixed streaming traffic. p95 decode latency up ~30ms. grabbing a quick profile now.

lina: can you paste the pprof/flamegraph when you have it?

sanjay: uploaded: https://internal.perf/fg/1838881234 (flamegraph)
sanjay: top hotspots: host.parse ~20%, net/http2 ~15%, kvcache.evict ~8%

alex: that kvcache evict number lines up with some stream resets we've been seeing. any ingress log samples?

sanjay: ```
[2026-03-15T12:23:11Z] stream_id=124 reset=RST_STREAM code=0x8 parse_ms=12 kvcache_evicted=3 kernel=quantize_q4_fastpath
[2026-03-15T12:23:11Z] stream_id=125 parse_ms=9 decode_ms=45 kernel=quantize_q4_fastpath
```

profiling-bot: perf-snapshot: host CPU +15% vs baseline (2026-03-13). Hot functions: host.parse, grpc.writev, kvcache.lock. Suggested tags: kernel=q4_fastpath, ingress=http2

jamie: quick hypothesis: kernel changes increase small-write pressure on HTTP2 framing which nudges more frequent kv evictions -> more host work. Try lowering batching delay and/or switch kernel_hint for a canary.

lina: proposal for experiments:
- canary A: batching.max_batch_delay_ms=3, batching.policy=latency, kv.prefetch=false, kernel_hint=fastpath (10% traffic)
- canary B: kernel_hint=legacy (10% traffic) + normal batching
Collect p50/p95/p99, kvcache.evictions/min, stream resets/min.

sanjay: quick microbench (local lab) with 1k concurrent streams:
- baseline (legacy): p95 total=120ms, kvcache_evictions=0.4/min
- q4_fastpath: p95 total=150ms, kvcache_evictions=1.8/min

sre-oncall: ack — I can book a canary window tonight 02:00-04:00 PST. Please provide the config PR and traffic routing before 01:30. I'll also pause proxy rolling during the window.

alex: add one more tweak: reduce http2.max_concurrent_streams to 250 on the canary path and enable connection-level keepalive to reduce churn.

lina: noted, will include http2 tuning in the PR. I'll also add a tiny perf harness to replay a 5k-stream sample so we can compare traces side-by-side.

sanjay: thanks. I'll push baseline numbers and the pprof artifacts to the canary doc and tag you all.

jamie: if canary A shows lower p95 but evictions persist, we should try KV cache resizing (shard + LRU window) as step 2.

lina: agreed. plan ready — opening PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pulls/2421
sanjay: pinged.

sre-oncall: good to go on my side once PR merges. I'll coordinate the window and post results in this thread. :thumbsup:
